data: Amazon swung from a net loss of $2,722 million in fiscal 2022 to net income of $59,248 million in fiscal 2024, an improvement of $61,970 million. Because the 2022 base is negative, a standard percentage change isn't meaningful: the formula gives roughly 2,277% (61,970 divided by the absolute value of 2,722), but that figure overstates the move since it measures growth from a loss rather than from a positive starting point. The clearer way to put it is that Amazon went from a loss to a profit, with 2024 net income also nearly doubling the $30,425 million earned in fiscal 2023 (about a 95% increase).
